protocol.note: this record performs no new measurement -- it assembles the EXP-B1 four-row column set (docs/HANDOFF-ENGINE.md:218-224, the D-071 100M-costed table's row labels) from four already-committed 30M records. warmups/reps/ceilings above describe this assembly step itself (a single pass), not the underlying measurements -- each row's own protocol is unchanged from its source record (see rows.*.source).

exp_b1.description: EXP-B1 / D-071's four-row column set (docs/HANDOFF-ENGINE.md §4, "100M, costed": store on disk, query-ready floor (VmHWM), columnar scan, version_history) at the 30M scale point, per docs/design/SCALE_BUILD_FORECAST_2026-09-15.md §4's expB1-{30,100}m.json layout. Every value below is read from a field already committed on main under benchmarks/scale-v1/ -- no new measurement was taken to produce this file. The 100M point is a separate file (expB1-100m.json), not yet produced (100M chain still running on iTiger).

store_on_disk.label: store on disk
store_on_disk.note: total_bytes is build_info.store_bytes.total_bytes as recorded; it exceeds manifest_bytes + segment_bytes (the store's own eventlog / working-copy overhead is not itemized further in the source record, so no additional breakdown is claimed here).

query_ready_floor.label: query-ready floor (VmHWM)
query_ready_floor.note: fresh read-only process, cold-opens the finished store and runs the 13-operator registry once each; VmHWM of that process. Job 213173 (the fixed, alone rerun -- see README's Deviations §1 for the writer-lock bug in the discarded first attempt, job 213068).

columnar_scan.label: columnar scan (aggregate_events, query id agg.rel_bucket)
columnar_scan.note: "columnar scan" is this operator's label in docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md's D-058-vs-D-069 comparison ("columnar control (aggregate_events)"), reused here as the HANDOFF-ENGINE table's third row. clean_213174_p50_ms is the clean (alone) rerun; contended_213069_p50_ms is job 213069's concurrent-run figure, kept on record per the campaign's non-overwrite discipline, not averaged in.

source.recomputed_from: benchmarks/scale-v1/scale-curve-30m-raw.json: results.native[query=="agg.rel_bucket"].timings_ms (median), matches p50_ms and clean_213174_p50_ms exactly -- see compute_b7_scale's own cross-check for this row

version_history.label: version_history (post D-069)
version_history.note: clean_alone (job 213175), median over 3 reps of wall_ms and vmhwm_kb -- not the contended_first_run (job 213070), kept on record separately.
